claim_summary: For each characteristic-two cyclic Klein cubic, the marked Gauss fixed scheme is the nonzero trace-zero finite étale scheme; all extension counts follow from subfield traces, and the cubic-threefold instance has three degree-five closed points.
integrity_statement: Exact symbolic and finite-field checks corroborate a general algebraic proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-point concept depends on the displayed ordered-coordinate identification with the dual projective space.
The theorem classifies fixed points, not higher-period Gauss points or other projective markings.
Historical priority remains qualified by the scope of inspected related literature.
title: Trace-zero Gauss-fixed schemes on characteristic-two cyclic Klein cubics
